arStrings.szText:
After spending {c_number}[{SF_2}]{/c} Primary Resource, you explode, dealing {c_random}[SF_17]{/c} Shadow damage and gaining a stack of {c_important}Abyssal Resonance{/c} for {c_number}[SF_3]{/c} seconds.{if:SF_14} The explosion Pulls In enemies while at {c_number}[SF_5]{/c} stacks of Abyssal Resonance.{/if}

Each stack of {c_important}Abyssal Resonance{/c} increases its Size by {c_number}[SF_1*100*2|x%|]{/c} and damage by {c_number}[SF_1*100|x%|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[SF_1*100*2*3|x%|]{/c} and {c_number}[SF_1*100*2|x%|]{/c} respectively.
Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier III and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
Every third explosion Pulls In enemies.
